findings.title: public checkpoint handoff 的 necessity/authority proof 未覆盖 exact normalization plan，且 Open Decision 仍允许扩大为 write-side checkpoint mechanics
findings.problem: 098 Proof D 已正确证明 EOF-only normalization authority属于 archive completed 之后的 exact authorize-checkpoint Owner boundary，并由 Executor mechanics执行；但 Proof E 进一步把‘stable runner缺少 public checkpoint handoff surface’定义为 H1 acceptance gap，声称公开现有 prepareCheckpointBoundaryHandoff()即可消除当前 canonical dogfood依赖聊天知道哪几个 EOF 文件。实际 production service只返回 changeId、Owner ref、canonical subject/trailers、通用 normalization scope/allowed/forbidden 与 Git preflight，不读取 Git working tree、candidate/archive-touched path set，也不返回具体需要 normalization 的文件/operation。因此 Evidence Boundary只证明‘已有 generic handoff contract可读’，没有证明‘public stable-runner surface可以从 repository facts确定 exact checkpoint hygiene plan并消除聊天依赖’。同时 §8 Open Decision 仍允许 public surface直接执行 EOF-only mutation；这不是 H1 formal required outcome已经证明必需的能力，并可能把 stable runner扩大为新的 write-side checkpoint executor/adapter surface。
findings.contractRef: Flowkit Explore Skill v2 §4.1 Scope/Prerequisite Proof、§4.3 Activation/Self-hosting、§5 Proof Acceptance Depth；flowkit-archive-and-checkpoint-boundary canonical spec ‘Checkpoint handoff必须绑定 exact Owner authorization且不执行 Git mutation’；03 Planned Changes v6 H1 stable runner/self-hosting acceptance；Operating Model v8 Executor/Git authority boundary
findings.invariant: Archive action不得获得 EOF normalization authority；EOF-only normalization只能在 exact authorize-checkpoint Owner fact存在后作为 Executor mechanics发生。H1如果新增 public checkpoint surface，必须是证明 self-hosting所必需的最小 closure，不能成为第二个 Checkpoint Adapter/Git automation，也不能把‘generic规则可读’误写成‘exact normalization plan可由 stable runner确定’。
findings.requiredOutcome: Revise Explore 收紧 Proof E/Feasible Proposal Boundary/Open Decisions。Reviewer不限定唯一实现：可以保留一个最薄 public surface，但必须用 disposable proof证明它从正式 repository/Git facts + exact Owner checkpoint authorization得到足够 deterministic 的 read-only checkpoint handoff/preflight（包括如果 acceptance声称消除聊天选文件，则必须证明 exact bounded path/operation plan如何确定）；实际 EOF bytes mutation仍留给授权后的 Executor mechanics。或者，如果无法证明 public surface是H1必需的，就从H1 required closure中删除它，E2E继续消费既有 F1 handoff contract + Executor mechanics。两种路径都不得让 archive执行 normalization，也不得自动 stage/commit/push/PR/merge。
acceptance: 明确确认 archive success只关闭 Change；EOF normalization时机仍是 completed → authorize-checkpoint Owner fact → Executor mechanics，archive Run/CLI不得执行 formatter或EOF mutation。

如果保留 public checkpoint surface：证明它是 H1 stable-runner/self-hosting所需的最小 operator/read projection，而不是新 lifecycle Action/Run/Agent Adapter；至少输出 exact Delivery/Change/Owner binding、subject/trailers、bounded normalization authority与preflight。

如果声称 public surface消除‘聊天知道哪几个 EOF 文件’依赖，则用 disposable canonical-like workspace实际证明 exact candidate/archive-touched path set与EOF-only operations可由 repository/Git facts确定；unrelated dirty、semantic/internal whitespace、trailing-space或broad-formatting case必须 fail closed。
public surface本身保持 read-only；不得自动修改 EOF bytes、stage、commit、push、merge/rebase。实际 EOF-only mutation仍由 exact authorize-checkpoint后的 Executor mechanics执行。
若 Author选择不新增 public surface，则证明 existing F1 handoff contract + Executor mechanics已足以让 H1 future-Delivery-shaped E2E在无聊天隐藏状态下完成 checkpoint，并删除Proof E中‘current stable runner acceptance FAIL’的过度结论。
不扩展 H1到 Checkpoint Adapter、Git automation、new checkpoint state、Registry或04 Engineering Health。
